changes: The FX track's DELAY HPF/LPF and REVERB FRQ/HPF/LPF read in hertz: filter_hz_gate sends ids 76..87 to filter_hz_fx_text (src/fx-hz.c), which reads the coefficient the stock DSP uses and works out the -3 dB frequency (HPF, LPF) or the shelf's corner (FRQ) with a 32-bit CORDIC; LPF reads HPF through stock's page value getter, so a held trig's or scene's lock counts. No stock table is copied.

Lock boxes: a table of box widths per id; the FX ids get 1.2.1's 33-pixel box, LPF's two pixels right (x-14..x+18). A third site, where stock's knob value drawing places a value's text (0x40037b9c, 10 bytes), moves LPF's locked text with its box, so locked HPF and LPF keep a black column between them.
Source-only export compiled from sdk/analog-rytm-mkii/modules/filter-hz at 6eb906493 in the pinned toolchain.
stockPolicy: No firmware or stock-derived code/tables are present. Addresses, lengths and SHA-256 guards are metadata; exported instructions and sections are authored module code. Local materialized recipes and firmware are never committed.
